shortDescription: South Korea’s excess tax revenue may exceed 50 trillion won ($37 billion) this year, according to Yonhap News, as a stronger-than-expected semiconductor cycle boosts collections.

title: South Korea’s Tax Windfall May Top 50 Trillion Won, Yonhap Says
